QuestInfo.name: Orbis
QuestInfo.0: It seems #b#p1002104##k has found some new information.
QuestInfo.1: #p1002104# notifies you of some new information regarding the Black Wings and asks you to head to #b#m200000000##k to meet #b#p2012012# the fairy#k. #p2012012# will probably have some more details about this.

0.0: Long time no see! You've leveled up a lot since the last time we met. You must be training really hard. Always hard-working. I'm not surprised. It's exactly what a hero like you would do. I'm sure #p1201000# will be happy to hear about your progress.
0.1: Anyway, enough small talk. I realized that it might be more effective to search for information in places outside Victoria Island as well, so I've begun investigating in Ossyria. I began with #b#m200000000##k and immediately hit the jackpot.
0.2: It seems like something strange is happening in #m200000000# in Ossyria. It's a bit different from when we were dealing with the puppeteer, but my instincts tell me it has to do with the Black Wings. Please head over to #m200000000#.

1.0: ...I'm sorry, but if you have something to tell me, could you do so another time? I haven't been getting much sleep lately, so I am dead tired.

npc.0: Why aren't you in #b#m200000000##k yet? Is it because you don't know how to get there? To get to #m200000000# from Victoria Island, take the airship from #bVictoria Tree Platform#k.
